title: Plan execution
summary: Cleanup heartbeat losses stay in the capture and cannot block case submission. A lost submission reply saves its request and payload as outcome_unknown; preserve it and ask the control-plane operator to inspect the cursor. No command replays an unrecorded submission. Re-entering yoke qa plan run while independent review is pending reprints that bundle and does not recapture. Once a verdict batch is recorded, the review wake for that execution is cancelled. The same command reprints passing verdicts and does not capture those requirements; a new capture of a passed requirement uses --replaces. Failed or undetermined requirements stay open, and re-entry begins a fresh execution that captures them. Item-target plan runs forward explicit checkout and branch selection into the immutable case roster using the owning session claim, including epics with integration and task lanes. Ambiguous or unauthorized lane selection refuses with qa_source_lane_unresolved and names the exact selection flags. An item plan run skips cases whose newest run passed at the lane's recorded head, then runs the remaining cases one execution target at a time, starting each target after the previous one passed; when every case already passed there it refuses with qa_plan_roster_passed_at_candidate. A live roster takes corrections only at cases the walk has not reached; the runner's check-in compares the roster digest and stops with qa_roster_corrected when it moved, and re-running the same command resumes on the corrected roster. A deployment-run plan run started after an abort leaves out cases whose newest run passed on the same execution target, including passes an aborted execution recorded, and a multi-host member moves on to the next host; passes on another target still require fresh runs, and a live execution keeps its roster. Cases a stopped execution's pending review holds stay out of the roster. When nothing is owed the run refuses with qa_plan_nothing_owed and lists the stage's blockers with their next commands instead of replaying the roster; once every case passed, stage acceptance settles against the newest stopped execution. Mission capture opens walking while any mission lacks its durable walk-end receipt; the final receipt enters awaiting_walk_review atomically. Ordinary captures enter awaiting_walk_review directly. Both states retain existing review authority and mission custody; completion alone is not a QA verdict. A single agent_mission requirement starts through yoke qa case run in a one-requirement plan execution with the same lease, walker, review bundle and main-agent verdict; sibling obligations stay untouched. An inherit mission requires its ordered predecessor and refuses single-case execution.
